app.title: MoCoCo
home.heading: Projects
home.subtitle: Co-create a movie commentary video with AI, stage by stage.
home.public_subtitle: Explore a complete example or import your own film into a browser project. AI generation is not yet available.
home.empty: No projects yet. Create one to get started.
home.delete_confirm: Delete project "{title}"? This removes all its files.
example.project_hint: Complete · inspect the actual script and shot choices
example.project_intro: Use the six stages on the left to inspect the actual script units, candidate frames, final clip choices, narration timing, and exported video.
example.captions_count: Descriptions were generated for {n} representative shots.
example.keyframes_hint: These {n} keyframes appear in shot candidates or the final cut. Click one to see its description.
example.shots_hint: Each narration unit shows its actual candidate frames. Blue marks the initial choice; green marks a frame used in the final cut. Click a frame for details.
example.cut_hint: Each row is one narration unit. Frames run left to right in final order; cards show source in/out points and clip duration.
example.title: Sherlock Jr. | From film to commentary
example.summary: Watch the result, read the script and six production steps, then start your own project.
example.intro: A 1924 silent-film example showing how MoCoCo develops a script, selects shots, adds narration and exports a video.
example.script_hint: Each paragraph is one story unit. Follow the opening hook, plot progression and closing callback.
example.stage.ingest_detail: Split the film into shots, extract keyframes, and describe representative frames.
example.stage.script_detail: Write eight Chinese narration units around the real-world, dream, real-world structure and identify each visual intent.
example.stage.shots_detail: Retrieve candidate shots by meaning, then review dream transitions, billiards, and the motorcycle chase.
example.stage.cut_detail: Arrange shot order and duration to follow the narration's rhythm.
example.stage.voice_detail: Create Chinese narration and align each unit in time.
example.stage.export_detail: Combine a 2m45s video with embedded Chinese subtitles.
browser.upload_hint: The public preview keeps this film in your browser, without sending it to the site server. Large files may exceed browser storage; clearing browser data may remove it. AI generation is not yet available.
browser.loading_or_missing: Loading project. If it is missing, return to the project list.
browser.delete_confirm: Delete this project and its movie from this browser?
browser.storage_note: The file stays in this browser. It cannot be recovered from the website on another device or after browser data is cleared.
browser.processing_notice: The public preview currently supports browsing the example and importing a film locally. Processing, AI writing, shot retrieval, narration and export are not connected to a public server yet. Explore the example to see the workflow.
newp.title: New project
newp.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - or _. Used as the folder name.
newp.film_from_computer: Choose a movie from your computer
newp.film_upload_hint: Creating the project uploads the movie to the website server for this project. Large files may take a few minutes.
newp.brief_placeholder: One paragraph describing what this commentary should cover. Leave empty and AI will improvise from the film itself.
wizard.busy: Another stage is already running for this project.
setup.title: Title
setup.shots_hint: Hover a frame for its caption; click to preview the clip.
setup.no_shots: Run this step to detect shots and generate keyframes and captions.
script.mismatch: Paragraph counts differ ({a} vs {b}); translation or segmentation may fail.
script.resegment_hint: Script text changed since segmentation; segments may be stale. Re-run Segment.
script.confirm_overwrite: A script already exists. Draft again and overwrite it?
script.no_units: Run Segment to break the script into units.
script.placeholder: Write the commentary here, one paragraph per unit, separated by a blank line.
shots.heading: Shots
shots.hint: Click a candidate to choose or unchoose it for this unit, then save.
shots.no_candidates: Run this step to retrieve candidate shots for each unit.
cut.heading: Cut
cut.hint: Reorder, trim, or remove clips within each unit.
cut.no_timeline: Run this step to assemble a rough cut from the chosen shots.
voice.heading: Voice
voice.no_langs: No voice languages configured for this project.
voice.upload_hint: Uploading your own recording replaces TTS narration. It must read the script in the same order, start to finish.
voice.no_timing: Run this step to synthesize narration and compute per-unit timing.
export.heading: Export
export.no_output: Run this step to render the final video.
analysis.title: From care to tragedy
analysis.hint: Inspect a review, compare frames and export your chosen claims. A prepared study, not live generation or a finished film.
images.export_note: External image attribution is included in end cards and a companion file. Rerender after changing images.
